description: China Airlines Dynasty Flyer miles for China Airlines flights. Miles = distance x booking-class % (J 175; C 150; D, W, U 125; A 115; E, Y, B, M 100; K, V, T 80; R, Q, H, N 50; L, O, Z, X, G, S 0), rounded to the nearest mile per flight, no minimum. The Gold, Emerald and Paragon incentive (15/25/30%) is a note only. Status Points per flight are not calculated; the thresholds are Gold 360, Emerald 720 and Paragon 1,400 Status Points (sp: the Status Points you have, for the progress). Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports. Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

cls.description: Booking class. J = J (Business Flex, 175%); C = C (Business Standard, 150%); D = D (Business Basic, 125%); W = W (Premium Economy Flex, 125%); U = U (Premium Economy Flex, 125%); A = A (Premium Economy Standard, 115%); E = E (Premium Economy Basic, 100%); Y = Y (Economy Flex, 100%); B = B (Economy Flex, 100%); M = M (Economy Flex, 100%); K = K (Economy Standard, 80%); V = V (Economy Standard, 80%); T = T (Economy Standard, 80%); R = R (Economy Basic, 50%); Q = Q (Economy Basic, 50%); H = H (Economy Basic, 50%); N = N (Economy Basic, 50%); L = L (Economy Discount, 0%); O = O (No miles); Z = Z (No miles); X = X (No miles); G = G (No miles); S = S (No miles). The letter on your ticket. Classes O, Z, X, G and S, and L, earn no miles.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter for creditTo, when it differs from the class question. Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of China Airlines's own: delta = Delta SkyMiles (creditStatus one of: SkyMiles Member, Silver Medallion, Gold Medallion, Platinum Medallion, Diamond Medallion); flying-club = Flying Club (creditStatus one of: Red, Silver, Gold); flying-blue = Flying Blue (creditStatus one of: Explorer, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ultimate). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The booking class is cls (or creditClass). The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

sp.description: Status Points you have in the last 12 months (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next tier; the flight's own Status Points are not added.

status.description: Your Dynasty Flyer tier. DY = Dynasty; GD = Gold; EM = Emerald; PG = Paragon. Gold, Emerald and Paragon members get incentive miles on top; the calculator shows them as a note.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
